# ─── Draw helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_node(ax, cx, cy, label, ntype):
    ec, fc, tc = TYPE_STYLE[ntype]
    if ntype == "decision":
        hw = NODE_W * 0.52
        hh = NODE_H * 1.05
        diam = plt.Polygon(
            [(cx, cy+hh), (cx+hw, cy), (cx, cy-hh), (cx-hw, cy)],
            closed=True, linewidth=0.7,
            edgecolor=ec, facecolor=fc, zorder=3
        )
        ax.add_patch(diam)
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.5, fontfamily="serif", color=tc, zorder=4,
                multialignment="center")
    elif ntype == "terminal":
        r = NODE_H * 0.65
        circ = plt.Circle((cx, cy), r,
                           linewidth=1.0, edgecolor=ec,
                           facecolor=fc, zorder=3)
        ax.add_patch(circ)
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.8, fontfamily="serif", color=tc, zorder=4,
                multialignment="center")
    else:
        box = FancyBboxPatch(
            (cx - NODE_W/2, cy - NODE_H/2), NODE_W, NODE_H,
            boxstyle=f"round,pad={CORNER}",
            linewidth=0.7, edgecolor=ec, facecolor=fc, zorder=3
        )
        ax.add_patch(box)
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.8, fontfamily="serif", color=tc, zorder=4,
                multialignment="center")

def draw_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, etype, lbl="", rad=0.0):
    col = EDGE_C[etype]
    ls  = (0, (4, 2)) if etype == "rollback" else "-"
    lw  = 0.8
    dx, dy = x1-x0, y1-y0
    dist   = (dx**2+dy**2)**0.5
    if dist < 0.01:
        return
    ux, uy = dx/dist, dy/dist
    # shrink start/end by node half-extent
    sk_x = NODE_W/2 * abs(ux) + NODE_H/2 * abs(uy)
    arr = FancyArrowPatch(
        (x0 + ux*sk_x*0.9, y0 + uy*sk_x*0.9),
        (x1 - ux*sk_x*0.9, y1 - uy*sk_x*0.9),
        arrowstyle=f"Simple,tail_width={lw*0.5},head_width=5,head_length=4",
        color=col, linewidth=lw, linestyle=ls,
        connectionstyle=f"arc3,rad={rad}",
        zorder=2, alpha=0.80,
    )
    ax.add_patch(arr)
    if lbl:
        mx = (x0 + x1)/2
        my = (y0 + y1)/2
        offset = 0.14 + abs(rad) * 0.6
        ax.text(mx, my + offset, lbl, ha="center", va="bottom",
                fontsize=4.5, fontfamily="serif", color=col,
                zorder=5, alpha=0.9)

    draw_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, etype, lbl, rad)

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# ─── Palette ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG     = "#fffff8"
TEXT   = "#111111"
TEXT2  = "#555555"
AXIS_C = "#cccccc"

LANE_BG = {
    "dev":        "#e8f0fa",
    "staging":    "#e8f7e8",
    "canary":     "#fdf4e3",
    "production": "#fbe8e8",
    "rollback":   "#fff0f0",
}
TYPE_STYLE = {
    # (edgecolor, facecolor, textcolor)
    "action":    ("#3a6fa8", "#d6e8f7", "#1a3a60"),
    "check":     ("#3a9993", "#d8f0ee", "#1a5550"),
    "decision":  ("#c87020", "#fde8c8", "#6a3800"),
    "hpa":       ("#7a50b8", "#ecdaf7", "#3a1870"),
    "bg":        ("#0e8a96", "#c0ecf0", "#055860"),
    "rollback":  ("#c83030", "#fad8d8", "#700000"),
    "alert":     ("#a81010", "#fad8d8", "#600000"),
    "terminal":  ("#1a7a20", "#c8e8c8", "#0a4010"),
}
EDGE_C = {
    "forward":    "#4a7ab8",
    "rollback":   "#c83030",
    "hpa_branch": "#8a60c8",
    "blue_green": "#0e8a96",
}

# ─── Layout parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Fixed figure 22 × 11.5 inches → 3300 × 1725 px @ 150 dpi
FIG_W, FIG_H = 22.0, 11.5
DPI = 150

LANE_NAMES = ["dev", "staging", "canary", "production"]

# Node grid: each env occupies its own horizontal region
# Dev: cols 0-6 (7 nodes), Staging: 7-11 (5), Canary: 12-18 (7), Prod: 19-27 (9)
# Total 28 cols in ~20 usable inches → col_w ≈ 0.72

USABLE_W = 20.5
N_COLS   = 28
COL_W    = USABLE_W / N_COLS       # ≈ 0.732
X_OFF    = 1.2                      # left margin for lane labels

LANE_H   = 1.80                     # per lane height
NODE_W   = COL_W * 0.82
NODE_H   = 0.52
CORNER   = 0.06

def xc(col):
    return X_OFF + col * COL_W + COL_W / 2

def yc(lane):
    idx = LANE_NAMES.index(lane)
    return idx * LANE_H + LANE_H / 2

# Rollback row sits below dev (y < 0)
RB_Y = -LANE_H * 0.5

# ─── Node definitions: (short_label, type, col, lane) ───────────────────────
NODES = {
    # Dev  (lane 0)
    "src-commit":    ("Source Commit\n& PR Merge",      "action",   0,  "dev"),
    "ci-build":      ("CI Build &\nUnit Tests",          "action",   1,  "dev"),
    "docker-push":   ("Docker Build\n& Push",            "action",   2,  "dev"),
    "dev-deploy":    ("Deploy to\nDev NS",               "action",   3,  "dev"),
    "dev-smoke":     ("Smoke Tests",                     "check",    4,  "dev"),
    "dev-hpa-check": ("HPA Check\nDev",                  "hpa",      5,  "dev"),
    "dev-gate":      ("Dev Gate\nerr≥5%",                "decision", 6,  "dev"),
    # Staging  (lane 1)
    "staging-deploy":      ("Deploy to\nStaging NS",          "action",   7,  "staging"),
    "staging-integration": ("Integration\n& E2E Tests",        "check",    8,  "staging"),
    "staging-hpa-check":   ("HPA Check\nStaging",              "hpa",      9,  "staging"),
    "staging-perf":        ("Perf / Load\nTests",              "check",    10, "staging"),
    "staging-gate":        ("Staging Gate\nerr≥2%",            "decision", 11, "staging"),
    # Canary  (lane 2)
    "canary-deploy":    ("Deploy Canary\n10% Traffic",     "action",   12, "canary"),
    "canary-observe":   ("Observe\n5 min",                 "check",    13, "canary"),
    "canary-hpa-check": ("HPA Check\nCanary",              "hpa",      14, "canary"),
    "canary-ramp-25":   ("Ramp 25%\nTraffic",              "action",   15, "canary"),
    "canary-observe-2": ("Observe\n10 min",                "check",    16, "canary"),
    "canary-ramp-50":   ("Ramp 50%\nTraffic",              "action",   17, "canary"),
    "canary-gate":      ("Canary Gate\nerr≥1%/p99≥250ms", "decision", 18, "canary"),
    # Production  (lane 3)
    "prod-blue-green-prep":  ("Prepare\nGreen Slot",          "bg",       19, "production"),
    "prod-deploy-green":     ("Deploy to\nGreen Slot",         "bg",       20, "production"),
    "prod-green-healthcheck":("Green Health\nCheck",           "check",    21, "production"),
    "prod-hpa-check":        ("HPA Check\nProd",               "hpa",      22, "production"),
    "prod-bg-switch-gate":   ("B/G Switch\nGate ≥0.5%",       "decision", 23, "production"),
    "prod-switch-traffic":   ("Switch 100%\nTraffic→Green",    "bg",       24, "production"),
    "prod-verify":           ("Post-Switch\nVerify 3 min",     "check",    25, "production"),
    "prod-finalize":         ("Decommission\nBlue Slot",       "bg",       26, "production"),
    "pipeline-complete":     ("Pipeline\nComplete",             "terminal", 27, "production"),
}

# Rollback & alert nodes placed in rollback row, positioned near their trigger
RB_NODES = {
    "rollback-dev":     ("Rollback Dev",          "rollback", 6),
    "rollback-staging": ("Rollback Staging",       "rollback", 11),
    "rollback-canary":  ("Rollback Canary",        "rollback", 18),
    "rollback-prod":    ("Revert→Blue",            "rollback", 23),
    "alert-oncall":     ("Alert On-Call\n& Incident", "alert", 27),
}

# ─── Compute centres ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
centres = {}
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col, lane) in NODES.items():
    centres[nid] = (xc(col), yc(lane))

# Rollback row y-positions are staggered per env to avoid pile-up
rb_y_map = {
    "rollback-dev":     RB_Y,
    "rollback-staging": RB_Y,
    "rollback-canary":  RB_Y,
    "rollback-prod":    RB_Y,
    "alert-oncall":     RB_Y,
}
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col) in RB_NODES.items():
    centres[nid] = (xc(col), rb_y_map[nid])

# ─── All node metadata merged ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALL_NODES = {}
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col, lane) in NODES.items():
    ALL_NODES[nid] = (lbl, ntype)
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col) in RB_NODES.items():
    ALL_NODES[nid] = (lbl, ntype)

# ─── Edges ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EDGES = [
    # Dev forward
    ("src-commit",    "ci-build",             "forward",    ""),
    ("ci-build",      "docker-push",          "forward",    "tests pass"),
    ("docker-push",   "dev-deploy",           "forward",    ""),
    ("dev-deploy",    "dev-smoke",            "forward",    ""),
    ("dev-smoke",     "dev-hpa-check",        "forward",    "pass"),
    ("dev-hpa-check", "dev-gate",             "forward",    "in range"),
    ("dev-gate",      "staging-deploy",       "forward",    "err<5%"),
    ("dev-gate",      "rollback-dev",         "rollback",   "err≥5%"),
    ("rollback-dev",  "alert-oncall",         "rollback",   ""),
    # Staging forward
    ("staging-deploy",      "staging-integration",  "forward",  ""),
    ("staging-integration", "staging-hpa-check",    "forward",  "pass"),
    ("staging-hpa-check",   "staging-perf",         "forward",  "in range"),
    ("staging-perf",        "staging-gate",         "forward",  "pass"),
    ("staging-gate",        "canary-deploy",        "forward",  "err<2%"),
    ("staging-gate",        "rollback-staging",     "rollback", "err≥2%"),
    ("staging-integration", "rollback-staging",     "rollback", "tests fail"),
    ("rollback-staging",    "alert-oncall",         "rollback", ""),
    # Canary forward
    ("canary-deploy",    "canary-observe",       "forward",  ""),
    ("canary-observe",   "canary-hpa-check",     "forward",  "OK"),
    ("canary-hpa-check", "canary-ramp-25",       "forward",  "in range"),
    ("canary-ramp-25",   "canary-observe-2",     "forward",  ""),
    ("canary-observe-2", "canary-ramp-50",       "forward",  "OK"),
    ("canary-ramp-50",   "canary-gate",          "forward",  ""),
    ("canary-gate",      "prod-blue-green-prep", "forward",  "err<1%\np99<250ms"),
    ("canary-gate",      "rollback-canary",      "rollback", "err≥1%"),
    ("canary-observe",   "rollback-canary",      "rollback", "degraded"),
    ("canary-observe-2", "rollback-canary",      "rollback", "degraded"),
    ("rollback-canary",  "alert-oncall",         "rollback", ""),
    # Production forward / blue-green
    ("prod-blue-green-prep",  "prod-deploy-green",      "blue_green", ""),
    ("prod-deploy-green",     "prod-green-healthcheck",  "blue_green", ""),
    ("prod-green-healthcheck","prod-hpa-check",          "forward",    "healthy"),
    ("prod-hpa-check",        "prod-bg-switch-gate",     "forward",    "in range"),
    ("prod-bg-switch-gate",   "prod-switch-traffic",     "blue_green", "err<0.5%\np99<200ms"),
    ("prod-bg-switch-gate",   "rollback-prod",           "rollback",   "err≥0.5%"),
    ("prod-green-healthcheck","rollback-prod",           "rollback",   "unhealthy"),
    ("rollback-prod",         "alert-oncall",            "rollback",   ""),
    ("prod-switch-traffic",   "prod-verify",             "blue_green", ""),
    ("prod-verify",           "prod-finalize",           "forward",    "verified"),
    ("prod-verify",           "rollback-prod",           "rollback",   "failed"),
    ("prod-finalize",         "pipeline-complete",       "forward",    ""),
]

# HPA edges (separate – drawn as faint dashed arcs upward to a shared HPA legend box)
HPA_EDGES = [
    ("dev-hpa-check",        "CPU>60%/Mem>70%\n1-5 replicas",   "dev"),
    ("staging-hpa-check",    "CPU>55%/Mem>65%\n2-10 replicas",  "staging"),
    ("canary-hpa-check",     "CPU>50%/Mem>60%\n2-15 replicas",  "canary"),
    ("prod-hpa-check",       "CPU>45%/Mem>55%\n5-50 replicas",  "production"),
]

# ─── Figure & axes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Palatino", "Palatino Linotype", "Georgia", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "figure.facecolor": BG,
    "axes.facecolor": BG,
    "savefig.facecolor": BG,
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.15,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H), dpi=DPI)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.axis("off")

TOTAL_X = X_OFF + N_COLS * COL_W + 0.3
TOTAL_Y = len(LANE_NAMES) * LANE_H

# ─── Swimlane backgrounds ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Column separators per environment
env_col_ranges = [
    ("dev",        0,  6,  "#3a6fa8"),
    ("staging",    7,  11, "#3a9993"),
    ("canary",     12, 18, "#c87020"),
    ("production", 19, 27, "#0e8a96"),
]

for lane_name in LANE_NAMES:
    idx = LANE_NAMES.index(lane_name)
    y0 = idx * LANE_H + 0.04
    rect = FancyBboxPatch(
        (X_OFF, y0), USABLE_W, LANE_H - 0.08,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
        linewidth=0.4, edgecolor=AXIS_C,
        facecolor=LANE_BG[lane_name], zorder=0
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(X_OFF - 0.1, y0 + (LANE_H - 0.08)/2,
            lane_name.capitalize(),
            fontsize=8.5, fontfamily="serif", color=TEXT2,
            va="center", ha="right", fontweight="bold")

# Rollback band
rb_h = LANE_H * 0.78
rb_y0 = -rb_h - 0.05
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
    (X_OFF, rb_y0), USABLE_W, rb_h,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
    linewidth=0.5, edgecolor="#c83030",
    facecolor=LANE_BG["rollback"], zorder=0, linestyle="--"
))
ax.text(X_OFF - 0.1, rb_y0 + rb_h/2,
        "Rollback\n/ Alert",
        fontsize=8, fontfamily="serif", color="#c83030",
        va="center", ha="right", fontweight="bold")

# Env boundary vertical lines
for _, c0, c1, col in env_col_ranges:
    bx = X_OFF + c0 * COL_W - COL_W * 0.3
    if c0 > 0:
        ax.axvline(bx, ymin=0.05, ymax=0.95,
                   color=AXIS_C, linewidth=0.6, linestyle=":", zorder=1,
                   clip_on=False)

# ─── Draw helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_node(ax, cx, cy, label, ntype):
    ec, fc, tc = TYPE_STYLE[ntype]
    if ntype == "decision":
        hw = NODE_W * 0.52
        hh = NODE_H * 1.05
        diam = plt.Polygon(
            [(cx, cy+hh), (cx+hw, cy), (cx, cy-hh), (cx-hw, cy)],
            closed=True, linewidth=0.7,
            edgecolor=ec, facecolor=fc, zorder=3
        )
        ax.add_patch(diam)
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.5, fontfamily="serif", color=tc, zorder=4,
                multialignment="center")
    elif ntype == "terminal":
        r = NODE_H * 0.65
        circ = plt.Circle((cx, cy), r,
                           linewidth=1.0, edgecolor=ec,
                           facecolor=fc, zorder=3)
        ax.add_patch(circ)
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.8, fontfamily="serif", color=tc, zorder=4,
                multialignment="center")
    else:
        box = FancyBboxPatch(
            (cx - NODE_W/2, cy - NODE_H/2), NODE_W, NODE_H,
            boxstyle=f"round,pad={CORNER}",
            linewidth=0.7, edgecolor=ec, facecolor=fc, zorder=3
        )
        ax.add_patch(box)
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.8, fontfamily="serif", color=tc, zorder=4,
                multialignment="center")

def draw_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, etype, lbl="", rad=0.0):
    col = EDGE_C[etype]
    ls  = (0, (4, 2)) if etype == "rollback" else "-"
    lw  = 0.8
    dx, dy = x1-x0, y1-y0
    dist   = (dx**2+dy**2)**0.5
    if dist < 0.01:
        return
    ux, uy = dx/dist, dy/dist
    # shrink start/end by node half-extent
    sk_x = NODE_W/2 * abs(ux) + NODE_H/2 * abs(uy)
    arr = FancyArrowPatch(
        (x0 + ux*sk_x*0.9, y0 + uy*sk_x*0.9),
        (x1 - ux*sk_x*0.9, y1 - uy*sk_x*0.9),
        arrowstyle=f"Simple,tail_width={lw*0.5},head_width=5,head_length=4",
        color=col, linewidth=lw, linestyle=ls,
        connectionstyle=f"arc3,rad={rad}",
        zorder=2, alpha=0.80,
    )
    ax.add_patch(arr)
    if lbl:
        mx = (x0 + x1)/2
        my = (y0 + y1)/2
        offset = 0.14 + abs(rad) * 0.6
        ax.text(mx, my + offset, lbl, ha="center", va="bottom",
                fontsize=4.5, fontfamily="serif", color=col,
                zorder=5, alpha=0.9)

# ─── Render nodes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for nid, (lbl, ntype) in ALL_NODES.items():
    cx, cy = centres[nid]
    draw_node(ax, cx, cy, lbl, ntype)

# ─── Render edges ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for frm, to, etype, lbl in EDGES:
    if frm not in centres or to not in centres:
        continue
    x0, y0 = centres[frm]
    x1, y1 = centres[to]

    # Determine curvature
    rad = 0.0
    if etype == "rollback":
        rad = 0.0  # straight down is fine for most
        if abs(x1 - x0) > COL_W * 3:
            rad = -0.15  # slight curve for long cross-lane rollbacks
    elif etype == "hpa_branch":
        rad = 0.25 if y1 > y0 else -0.25

    draw_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, etype, lbl, rad)

# ─── HPA threshold annotations ───────────────────────────────────────────────
for nid, annotation, lane in HPA_EDGES:
    cx, cy = centres[nid]
    # Small annotation box below the HPA node
    ax.text(cx, cy - NODE_H/2 - 0.16, annotation,
            ha="center", va="top",
            fontsize=4.2, fontfamily="serif",
            color="#5a30a0", alpha=0.8, zorder=6,
            style="italic",
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc="#f5eeff",
                      ec="#b090d8", lw=0.4, alpha=0.85))

# ─── Blue-green zone bracket ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
bg_node_ids = ["prod-blue-green-prep", "prod-deploy-green",
               "prod-green-healthcheck", "prod-switch-traffic",
               "prod-finalize"]
bg_xs = [centres[n][0] for n in bg_node_ids]
bg_cy = yc("production")
if bg_xs:
    bx0 = min(bg_xs) - NODE_W/2 - 0.08
    bx1 = max(bg_xs) + NODE_W/2 + 0.08
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
        (bx0, bg_cy - NODE_H/2 - 0.18),
        bx1 - bx0, NODE_H + 0.36,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
        linewidth=0.9, edgecolor="#0e8a96",
        facecolor="none", linestyle=(0, (4, 2)), zorder=5
    ))
    ax.text((bx0+bx1)/2, bg_cy + NODE_H/2 + 0.24,
            "Blue-Green Deployment Zone",
            ha="center", va="bottom",
            fontsize=6, fontfamily="serif",
            color="#0e8a96", style="italic", zorder=6)

# ─── Environment header labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────
env_header_y = TOTAL_Y + 0.22
for env, c0, c1, col in env_col_ranges:
    mid_x = (xc(c0) + xc(c1)) / 2
    bx0 = xc(c0) - NODE_W/2 - 0.04
    bx1 = xc(c1) + NODE_W/2 + 0.04
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
        (bx0, env_header_y - 0.14), bx1-bx0, 0.30,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
        linewidth=0.6, edgecolor=col,
        facecolor=LANE_BG.get(env, "#f0f0f0"), zorder=6
    ))
    ax.text(mid_x, env_header_y,
            env.upper(), ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=7.5, fontfamily="serif",
            color=col, fontweight="bold", zorder=7)

# ─── Legend ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# ─── Titles ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# ─── Palette ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG     = "#fffff8"
TEXT   = "#111111"
TEXT2  = "#555555"
AXIS_C = "#cccccc"

LANE_BG = {
    "dev":        "#e8f0fa",
    "staging":    "#e8f7e8",
    "canary":     "#fdf4e3",
    "production": "#fbe8e8",
    "rollback":   "#fff0f0",
}
TYPE_STYLE = {
    # (edgecolor, facecolor, textcolor)
    "action":    ("#3a6fa8", "#d6e8f7", "#1a3a60"),
    "check":     ("#3a9993", "#d8f0ee", "#1a5550"),
    "decision":  ("#c87020", "#fde8c8", "#6a3800"),
    "hpa":       ("#7a50b8", "#ecdaf7", "#3a1870"),
    "bg":        ("#0e8a96", "#c0ecf0", "#055860"),
    "rollback":  ("#c83030", "#fad8d8", "#700000"),
    "alert":     ("#a81010", "#fad8d8", "#600000"),
    "terminal":  ("#1a7a20", "#c8e8c8", "#0a4010"),
}
EDGE_C = {
    "forward":    "#4a7ab8",
    "rollback":   "#c83030",
    "hpa_branch": "#8a60c8",
    "blue_green": "#0e8a96",
}

# ─── Layout parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Fixed figure 22 × 11.5 inches → 3300 × 1725 px @ 150 dpi
FIG_W, FIG_H = 22.0, 11.5
DPI = 150

LANE_NAMES = ["dev", "staging", "canary", "production"]

# Node grid: each env occupies its own horizontal region
# Dev: cols 0-6 (7 nodes), Staging: 7-11 (5), Canary: 12-18 (7), Prod: 19-27 (9)
# Total 28 cols in ~20 usable inches → col_w ≈ 0.72

USABLE_W = 20.5
N_COLS   = 28
COL_W    = USABLE_W / N_COLS       # ≈ 0.732
X_OFF    = 1.2                      # left margin for lane labels

LANE_H   = 1.80                     # per lane height
NODE_W   = COL_W * 0.82
NODE_H   = 0.52
CORNER   = 0.06

def xc(col):
    return X_OFF + col * COL_W + COL_W / 2

def yc(lane):
    idx = LANE_NAMES.index(lane)
    return idx * LANE_H + LANE_H / 2

# Rollback row sits below dev (y < 0)
RB_Y = -LANE_H * 0.5

# ─── Node definitions: (short_label, type, col, lane) ───────────────────────
NODES = {
    # Dev  (lane 0)
    "src-commit":    ("Source Commit\n& PR Merge",      "action",   0,  "dev"),
    "ci-build":      ("CI Build &\nUnit Tests",          "action",   1,  "dev"),
    "docker-push":   ("Docker Build\n& Push",            "action",   2,  "dev"),
    "dev-deploy":    ("Deploy to\nDev NS",               "action",   3,  "dev"),
    "dev-smoke":     ("Smoke Tests",                     "check",    4,  "dev"),
    "dev-hpa-check": ("HPA Check\nDev",                  "hpa",      5,  "dev"),
    "dev-gate":      ("Dev Gate\nerr≥5%",                "decision", 6,  "dev"),
    # Staging  (lane 1)
    "staging-deploy":      ("Deploy to\nStaging NS",          "action",   7,  "staging"),
    "staging-integration": ("Integration\n& E2E Tests",        "check",    8,  "staging"),
    "staging-hpa-check":   ("HPA Check\nStaging",              "hpa",      9,  "staging"),
    "staging-perf":        ("Perf / Load\nTests",              "check",    10, "staging"),
    "staging-gate":        ("Staging Gate\nerr≥2%",            "decision", 11, "staging"),
    # Canary  (lane 2)
    "canary-deploy":    ("Deploy Canary\n10% Traffic",     "action",   12, "canary"),
    "canary-observe":   ("Observe\n5 min",                 "check",    13, "canary"),
    "canary-hpa-check": ("HPA Check\nCanary",              "hpa",      14, "canary"),
    "canary-ramp-25":   ("Ramp 25%\nTraffic",              "action",   15, "canary"),
    "canary-observe-2": ("Observe\n10 min",                "check",    16, "canary"),
    "canary-ramp-50":   ("Ramp 50%\nTraffic",              "action",   17, "canary"),
    "canary-gate":      ("Canary Gate\nerr≥1%/p99≥250ms", "decision", 18, "canary"),
    # Production  (lane 3)
    "prod-blue-green-prep":  ("Prepare\nGreen Slot",          "bg",       19, "production"),
    "prod-deploy-green":     ("Deploy to\nGreen Slot",         "bg",       20, "production"),
    "prod-green-healthcheck":("Green Health\nCheck",           "check",    21, "production"),
    "prod-hpa-check":        ("HPA Check\nProd",               "hpa",      22, "production"),
    "prod-bg-switch-gate":   ("B/G Switch\nGate ≥0.5%",       "decision", 23, "production"),
    "prod-switch-traffic":   ("Switch 100%\nTraffic→Green",    "bg",       24, "production"),
    "prod-verify":           ("Post-Switch\nVerify 3 min",     "check",    25, "production"),
    "prod-finalize":         ("Decommission\nBlue Slot",       "bg",       26, "production"),
    "pipeline-complete":     ("Pipeline\nComplete",             "terminal", 27, "production"),
}

# Rollback & alert nodes placed in rollback row, positioned near their trigger
RB_NODES = {
    "rollback-dev":     ("Rollback Dev",          "rollback", 6),
    "rollback-staging": ("Rollback Staging",       "rollback", 11),
    "rollback-canary":  ("Rollback Canary",        "rollback", 18),
    "rollback-prod":    ("Revert→Blue",            "rollback", 23),
    "alert-oncall":     ("Alert On-Call\n& Incident", "alert", 27),
}

# ─── Compute centres ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
centres = {}
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col, lane) in NODES.items():
    centres[nid] = (xc(col), yc(lane))

# Rollback row y-positions are staggered per env to avoid pile-up
rb_y_map = {
    "rollback-dev":     RB_Y,
    "rollback-staging": RB_Y,
    "rollback-canary":  RB_Y,
    "rollback-prod":    RB_Y,
    "alert-oncall":     RB_Y,
}
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col) in RB_NODES.items():
    centres[nid] = (xc(col), rb_y_map[nid])

# ─── All node metadata merged ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALL_NODES = {}
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col, lane) in NODES.items():
    ALL_NODES[nid] = (lbl, ntype)
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col) in RB_NODES.items():
    ALL_NODES[nid] = (lbl, ntype)

# ─── Edges ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EDGES = [
    # Dev forward
    ("src-commit",    "ci-build",             "forward",    ""),
    ("ci-build",      "docker-push",          "forward",    "tests pass"),
    ("docker-push",   "dev-deploy",           "forward",    ""),
    ("dev-deploy",    "dev-smoke",            "forward",    ""),
    ("dev-smoke",     "dev-hpa-check",        "forward",    "pass"),
    ("dev-hpa-check", "dev-gate",             "forward",    "in range"),
    ("dev-gate",      "staging-deploy",       "forward",    "err<5%"),
    ("dev-gate",      "rollback-dev",         "rollback",   "err≥5%"),
    ("rollback-dev",  "alert-oncall",         "rollback",   ""),
    # Staging forward
    ("staging-deploy",      "staging-integration",  "forward",  ""),
    ("staging-integration", "staging-hpa-check",    "forward",  "pass"),
    ("staging-hpa-check",   "staging-perf",         "forward",  "in range"),
    ("staging-perf",        "staging-gate",         "forward",  "pass"),
    ("staging-gate",        "canary-deploy",        "forward",  "err<2%"),
    ("staging-gate",        "rollback-staging",     "rollback", "err≥2%"),
    ("staging-integration", "rollback-staging",     "rollback", "tests fail"),
    ("rollback-staging",    "alert-oncall",         "rollback", ""),
    # Canary forward
    ("canary-deploy",    "canary-observe",       "forward",  ""),
    ("canary-observe",   "canary-hpa-check",     "forward",  "OK"),
    ("canary-hpa-check", "canary-ramp-25",       "forward",  "in range"),
    ("canary-ramp-25",   "canary-observe-2",     "forward",  ""),
    ("canary-observe-2", "canary-ramp-50",       "forward",  "OK"),
    ("canary-ramp-50",   "canary-gate",          "forward",  ""),
    ("canary-gate",      "prod-blue-green-prep", "forward",  "err<1%\np99<250ms"),
    ("canary-gate",      "rollback-canary",      "rollback", "err≥1%"),
    ("canary-observe",   "rollback-canary",      "rollback", "degraded"),
    ("canary-observe-2", "rollback-canary",      "rollback", "degraded"),
    ("rollback-canary",  "alert-oncall",         "rollback", ""),
    # Production forward / blue-green
    ("prod-blue-green-prep",  "prod-deploy-green",      "blue_green", ""),
    ("prod-deploy-green",     "prod-green-healthcheck",  "blue_green", ""),
    ("prod-green-healthcheck","prod-hpa-check",          "forward",    "healthy"),
    ("prod-hpa-check",        "prod-bg-switch-gate",     "forward",    "in range"),
    ("prod-bg-switch-gate",   "prod-switch-traffic",     "blue_green", "err<0.5%\np99<200ms"),
    ("prod-bg-switch-gate",   "rollback-prod",           "rollback",   "err≥0.5%"),
    ("prod-green-healthcheck","rollback-prod",           "rollback",   "unhealthy"),
    ("rollback-prod",         "alert-oncall",            "rollback",   ""),
    ("prod-switch-traffic",   "prod-verify",             "blue_green", ""),
    ("prod-verify",           "prod-finalize",           "forward",    "verified"),
    ("prod-verify",           "rollback-prod",           "rollback",   "failed"),
    ("prod-finalize",         "pipeline-complete",       "forward",    ""),
]

# HPA edges (separate – drawn as faint dashed arcs upward to a shared HPA legend box)
HPA_EDGES = [
    ("dev-hpa-check",        "CPU>60%/Mem>70%\n1-5 replicas",   "dev"),
    ("staging-hpa-check",    "CPU>55%/Mem>65%\n2-10 replicas",  "staging"),
    ("canary-hpa-check",     "CPU>50%/Mem>60%\n2-15 replicas",  "canary"),
    ("prod-hpa-check",       "CPU>45%/Mem>55%\n5-50 replicas",  "production"),
]

# ─── Figure & axes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Palatino", "Palatino Linotype", "Georgia", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "figure.facecolor": BG,
    "axes.facecolor": BG,
    "savefig.facecolor": BG,
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.15,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H), dpi=DPI)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.axis("off")

TOTAL_X = X_OFF + N_COLS * COL_W + 0.3
TOTAL_Y = len(LANE_NAMES) * LANE_H

# ─── Swimlane backgrounds ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Column separators per environment
env_col_ranges = [
    ("dev",        0,  6,  "#3a6fa8"),
    ("staging",    7,  11, "#3a9993"),
    ("canary",     12, 18, "#c87020"),
    ("production", 19, 27, "#0e8a96"),
]

for lane_name in LANE_NAMES:
    idx = LANE_NAMES.index(lane_name)
    y0 = idx * LANE_H + 0.04
    rect = FancyBboxPatch(
        (X_OFF, y0), USABLE_W, LANE_H - 0.08,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
        linewidth=0.4, edgecolor=AXIS_C,
        facecolor=LANE_BG[lane_name], zorder=0
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(X_OFF - 0.1, y0 + (LANE_H - 0.08)/2,
            lane_name.capitalize(),
            fontsize=8.5, fontfamily="serif", color=TEXT2,
            va="center", ha="right", fontweight="bold")

# Rollback band
rb_h = LANE_H * 0.78
rb_y0 = -rb_h - 0.05
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
    (X_OFF, rb_y0), USABLE_W, rb_h,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
    linewidth=0.5, edgecolor="#c83030",
    facecolor=LANE_BG["rollback"], zorder=0, linestyle="--"
))
ax.text(X_OFF - 0.1, rb_y0 + rb_h/2,
        "Rollback\n/ Alert",
        fontsize=8, fontfamily="serif", color="#c83030",
        va="center", ha="right", fontweight="bold")

# Env boundary vertical lines
for _, c0, c1, col in env_col_ranges:
    bx = X_OFF + c0 * COL_W - COL_W * 0.3
    if c0 > 0:
        ax.axvline(bx, ymin=0.05, ymax=0.95,
                   color=AXIS_C, linewidth=0.6, linestyle=":", zorder=1,
                   clip_on=False)

# ─── Draw helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_node(ax, cx, cy, label, ntype):
    ec, fc, tc = TYPE_STYLE[ntype]
    if ntype == "decision":
        hw = NODE_W * 0.52
        hh = NODE_H * 1.05
        diam = plt.Polygon(
            [(cx, cy+hh), (cx+hw, cy), (cx, cy-hh), (cx-hw, cy)],
            closed=True, linewidth=0.7,
            edgecolor=ec, facecolor=fc, zorder=3
        )
        ax.add_patch(diam)
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.5, fontfamily="serif", color=tc, zorder=4,
                multialignment="center")
    elif ntype == "terminal":
        r = NODE_H * 0.65
        circ = plt.Circle((cx, cy), r,
                           linewidth=1.0, edgecolor=ec,
                           facecolor=fc, zorder=3)
        ax.add_patch(circ)
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.8, fontfamily="serif", color=tc, zorder=4,
                multialignment="center")
    else:
        box = FancyBboxPatch(
            (cx - NODE_W/2, cy - NODE_H/2), NODE_W, NODE_H,
            boxstyle=f"round,pad={CORNER}",
            linewidth=0.7, edgecolor=ec, facecolor=fc, zorder=3
        )
        ax.add_patch(box)
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.8, fontfamily="serif", color=tc, zorder=4,
                multialignment="center")

def draw_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, etype, lbl="", rad=0.0):
    col = EDGE_C[etype]
    ls  = (0, (4, 2)) if etype == "rollback" else "-"
    lw  = 0.8
    dx, dy = x1-x0, y1-y0
    dist   = (dx**2+dy**2)**0.5
    if dist < 0.01:
        return
    ux, uy = dx/dist, dy/dist
    # shrink start/end by node half-extent
    sk_x = NODE_W/2 * abs(ux) + NODE_H/2 * abs(uy)
    arr = FancyArrowPatch(
        (x0 + ux*sk_x*0.9, y0 + uy*sk_x*0.9),
        (x1 - ux*sk_x*0.9, y1 - uy*sk_x*0.9),
        arrowstyle=f"Simple,tail_width={lw*0.5},head_width=5,head_length=4",
        color=col, linewidth=lw, linestyle=ls,
        connectionstyle=f"arc3,rad={rad}",
        zorder=2, alpha=0.80,
    )
    ax.add_patch(arr)
    if lbl:
        mx = (x0 + x1)/2
        my = (y0 + y1)/2
        offset = 0.14 + abs(rad) * 0.6
        ax.text(mx, my + offset, lbl, ha="center", va="bottom",
                fontsize=4.5, fontfamily="serif", color=col,
                zorder=5, alpha=0.9)

# ─── Render nodes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for nid, (lbl, ntype) in ALL_NODES.items():
    cx, cy = centres[nid]
    draw_node(ax, cx, cy, lbl, ntype)

# ─── Render edges ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for frm, to, etype, lbl in EDGES:
    if frm not in centres or to not in centres:
        continue
    x0, y0 = centres[frm]
    x1, y1 = centres[to]

    # Determine curvature
    rad = 0.0
    if etype == "rollback":
        rad = 0.0  # straight down is fine for most
        if abs(x1 - x0) > COL_W * 3:
            rad = -0.15  # slight curve for long cross-lane rollbacks
    elif etype == "hpa_branch":
        rad = 0.25 if y1 > y0 else -0.25

    draw_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, etype, lbl, rad)

# ─── HPA threshold annotations ───────────────────────────────────────────────
for nid, annotation, lane in HPA_EDGES:
    cx, cy = centres[nid]
    # Small annotation box below the HPA node
    ax.text(cx, cy - NODE_H/2 - 0.16, annotation,
            ha="center", va="top",
            fontsize=4.2, fontfamily="serif",
            color="#5a30a0", alpha=0.8, zorder=6,
            style="italic",
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc="#f5eeff",
                      ec="#b090d8", lw=0.4, alpha=0.85))

# ─── Blue-green zone bracket ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
bg_node_ids = ["prod-blue-green-prep", "prod-deploy-green",
               "prod-green-healthcheck", "prod-switch-traffic",
               "prod-finalize"]
bg_xs = [centres[n][0] for n in bg_node_ids]
bg_cy = yc("production")
if bg_xs:
    bx0 = min(bg_xs) - NODE_W/2 - 0.08
    bx1 = max(bg_xs) + NODE_W/2 + 0.08
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
        (bx0, bg_cy - NODE_H/2 - 0.18),
        bx1 - bx0, NODE_H + 0.36,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
        linewidth=0.9, edgecolor="#0e8a96",
        facecolor="none", linestyle=(0, (4, 2)), zorder=5
    ))
    ax.text((bx0+bx1)/2, bg_cy + NODE_H/2 + 0.24,
            "Blue-Green Deployment Zone",
            ha="center", va="bottom",
            fontsize=6, fontfamily="serif",
            color="#0e8a96", style="italic", zorder=6)

# ─── Environment header labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────
env_header_y = TOTAL_Y + 0.22
for env, c0, c1, col in env_col_ranges:
    mid_x = (xc(c0) + xc(c1)) / 2
    bx0 = xc(c0) - NODE_W/2 - 0.04

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# ─── Palette ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG     = "#fffff8"
TEXT   = "#111111"
TEXT2  = "#555555"
AXIS_C = "#cccccc"

LANE_BG = {
    "dev":        "#e8f0fa",
    "staging":    "#e8f7e8",
    "canary":     "#fdf4e3",
    "production": "#fbe8e8",
    "rollback":   "#fff0f0",
}
TYPE_STYLE = {
    # (edgecolor, facecolor, textcolor)
    "action":    ("#3a6fa8", "#d6e8f7", "#1a3a60"),
    "check":     ("#3a9993", "#d8f0ee", "#1a5550"),
    "decision":  ("#c87020", "#fde8c8", "#6a3800"),
    "hpa":       ("#7a50b8", "#ecdaf7", "#3a1870"),
    "bg":        ("#0e8a96", "#c0ecf0", "#055860"),
    "rollback":  ("#c83030", "#fad8d8", "#700000"),
    "alert":     ("#a81010", "#fad8d8", "#600000"),
    "terminal":  ("#1a7a20", "#c8e8c8", "#0a4010"),
}
EDGE_C = {
    "forward":    "#4a7ab8",
    "rollback":   "#c83030",
    "hpa_branch": "#8a60c8",
    "blue_green": "#0e8a96",
}

# ─── Layout parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Fixed figure 22 × 11.5 inches → 3300 × 1725 px @ 150 dpi
FIG_W, FIG_H = 22.0, 11.5
DPI = 150

LANE_NAMES = ["dev", "staging", "canary", "production"]

# Node grid: each env occupies its own horizontal region
# Dev: cols 0-6 (7 nodes), Staging: 7-11 (5), Canary: 12-18 (7), Prod: 19-27 (9)
# Total 28 cols in ~20 usable inches → col_w ≈ 0.72

USABLE_W = 20.5
N_COLS   = 28
COL_W    = USABLE_W / N_COLS       # ≈ 0.732
X_OFF    = 1.2                      # left margin for lane labels

LANE_H   = 1.80                     # per lane height
NODE_W   = COL_W * 0.82
NODE_H   = 0.52
CORNER   = 0.06

def xc(col):
    return X_OFF + col * COL_W + COL_W / 2

def yc(lane):
    idx = LANE_NAMES.index(lane)
    return idx * LANE_H + LANE_H / 2

# Rollback row sits below dev (y < 0)
RB_Y = -LANE_H * 0.5

# ─── Node definitions: (short_label, type, col, lane) ───────────────────────
NODES = {
    # Dev  (lane 0)
    "src-commit":    ("Source Commit\n& PR Merge",      "action",   0,  "dev"),
    "ci-build":      ("CI Build &\nUnit Tests",          "action",   1,  "dev"),
    "docker-push":   ("Docker Build\n& Push",            "action",   2,  "dev"),
    "dev-deploy":    ("Deploy to\nDev NS",               "action",   3,  "dev"),
    "dev-smoke":     ("Smoke Tests",                     "check",    4,  "dev"),
    "dev-hpa-check": ("HPA Check\nDev",                  "hpa",      5,  "dev"),
    "dev-gate":      ("Dev Gate\nerr≥5%",                "decision", 6,  "dev"),
    # Staging  (lane 1)
    "staging-deploy":      ("Deploy to\nStaging NS",          "action",   7,  "staging"),
    "staging-integration": ("Integration\n& E2E Tests",        "check",    8,  "staging"),
    "staging-hpa-check":   ("HPA Check\nStaging",              "hpa",      9,  "staging"),
    "staging-perf":        ("Perf / Load\nTests",              "check",    10, "staging"),
    "staging-gate":        ("Staging Gate\nerr≥2%",            "decision", 11, "staging"),
    # Canary  (lane 2)
    "canary-deploy":    ("Deploy Canary\n10% Traffic",     "action",   12, "canary"),
    "canary-observe":   ("Observe\n5 min",                 "check",    13, "canary"),
    "canary-hpa-check": ("HPA Check\nCanary",              "hpa",      14, "canary"),
    "canary-ramp-25":   ("Ramp 25%\nTraffic",              "action",   15, "canary"),
    "canary-observe-2": ("Observe\n10 min",                "check",    16, "canary"),
    "canary-ramp-50":   ("Ramp 50%\nTraffic",              "action",   17, "canary"),
    "canary-gate":      ("Canary Gate\nerr≥1%/p99≥250ms", "decision", 18, "canary"),
    # Production  (lane 3)
    "prod-blue-green-prep":  ("Prepare\nGreen Slot",          "bg",       19, "production"),
    "prod-deploy-green":     ("Deploy to\nGreen Slot",         "bg",       20, "production"),
    "prod-green-healthcheck":("Green Health\nCheck",           "check",    21, "production"),
    "prod-hpa-check":        ("HPA Check\nProd",               "hpa",      22, "production"),
    "prod-bg-switch-gate":   ("B/G Switch\nGate ≥0.5%",       "decision", 23, "production"),
    "prod-switch-traffic":   ("Switch 100%\nTraffic→Green",    "bg",       24, "production"),
    "prod-verify":           ("Post-Switch\nVerify 3 min",     "check",    25, "production"),
    "prod-finalize":         ("Decommission\nBlue Slot",       "bg",       26, "production"),
    "pipeline-complete":     ("Pipeline\nComplete",             "terminal", 27, "production"),
}

# Rollback & alert nodes placed in rollback row, positioned near their trigger
RB_NODES = {
    "rollback-dev":     ("Rollback Dev",          "rollback", 6),
    "rollback-staging": ("Rollback Staging",       "rollback", 11),
    "rollback-canary":  ("Rollback Canary",        "rollback", 18),
    "rollback-prod":    ("Revert→Blue",            "rollback", 23),
    "alert-oncall":     ("Alert On-Call\n& Incident", "alert", 27),
}

# ─── Compute centres ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
centres = {}
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col, lane) in NODES.items():
    centres[nid] = (xc(col), yc(lane))

# Rollback row y-positions are staggered per env to avoid pile-up
rb_y_map = {
    "rollback-dev":     RB_Y,
    "rollback-staging": RB_Y,
    "rollback-canary":  RB_Y,
    "rollback-prod":    RB_Y,
    "alert-oncall":     RB_Y,
}
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col) in RB_NODES.items():
    centres[nid] = (xc(col), rb_y_map[nid])

# ─── All node metadata merged ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALL_NODES = {}
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col, lane) in NODES.items():
    ALL_NODES[nid] = (lbl, ntype)
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col) in RB_NODES.items():
    ALL_NODES[nid] = (lbl, ntype)

# ─── Edges ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EDGES = [
    # Dev forward
    ("src-commit",    "ci-build",             "forward",    ""),
    ("ci-build",      "docker-push",          "forward",    "tests pass"),
    ("docker-push",   "dev-deploy",           "forward",    ""),
    ("dev-deploy",    "dev-smoke",            "forward",    ""),
    ("dev-smoke",     "dev-hpa-check",        "forward",    "pass"),
    ("dev-hpa-check", "dev-gate",             "forward",    "in range"),
    ("dev-gate",      "staging-deploy",       "forward",    "err<5%"),
    ("dev-gate",      "rollback-dev",         "rollback",   "err≥5%"),
    ("rollback-dev",  "alert-oncall",         "rollback",   ""),
    # Staging forward
    ("staging-deploy",      "staging-integration",  "forward",  ""),
    ("staging-integration", "staging-hpa-check",    "forward",  "pass"),
    ("staging-hpa-check",   "staging-perf",         "forward",  "in range"),
    ("staging-perf",        "staging-gate",         "forward",  "pass"),
    ("staging-gate",        "canary-deploy",        "forward",  "err<2%"),
    ("staging-gate",        "rollback-staging",     "rollback", "err≥2%"),
    ("staging-integration", "rollback-staging",     "rollback", "tests fail"),
    ("rollback-staging",    "alert-oncall",         "rollback", ""),
    # Canary forward
    ("canary-deploy",    "canary-observe",       "forward",  ""),
    ("canary-observe",   "canary-hpa-check",     "forward",  "OK"),
    ("canary-hpa-check", "canary-ramp-25",       "forward",  "in range"),
    ("canary-ramp-25",   "canary-observe-2",     "forward",  ""),
    ("canary-observe-2", "canary-ramp-50",       "forward",  "OK"),
    ("canary-ramp-50",   "canary-gate",          "forward",  ""),
    ("canary-gate",      "prod-blue-green-prep", "forward",  "err<1%\np99<250ms"),
    ("canary-gate",      "rollback-canary",      "rollback", "err≥1%"),
    ("canary-observe",   "rollback-canary",      "rollback", "degraded"),
    ("canary-observe-2", "rollback-canary",      "rollback", "degraded"),
    ("rollback-canary",  "alert-oncall",         "rollback", ""),
    # Production forward / blue-green
    ("prod-blue-green-prep",  "prod-deploy-green",      "blue_green", ""),
    ("prod-deploy-green",     "prod-green-healthcheck",  "blue_green", ""),
    ("prod-green-healthcheck","prod-hpa-check",          "forward",    "healthy"),
    ("prod-hpa-check",        "prod-bg-switch-gate",     "forward",    "in range"),
    ("prod-bg-switch-gate",   "prod-switch-traffic",     "blue_green", "err<0.5%\np99<200ms"),
    ("prod-bg-switch-gate",   "rollback-prod",           "rollback",   "err≥0.5%"),
    ("prod-green-healthcheck","rollback-prod",           "rollback",   "unhealthy"),
    ("rollback-prod",         "alert-oncall",            "rollback",   ""),
    ("prod-switch-traffic",   "prod-verify",             "blue_green", ""),
    ("prod-verify",           "prod-finalize",           "forward",    "verified"),
    ("prod-verify",           "rollback-prod",           "rollback",   "failed"),
    ("prod-finalize",         "pipeline-complete",       "forward",    ""),
]

# HPA edges (separate – drawn as faint dashed arcs upward to a shared HPA legend box)
HPA_EDGES = [
    ("dev-hpa-check",        "CPU>60%/Mem>70%\n1-5 replicas",   "dev"),
    ("staging-hpa-check",    "CPU>55%/Mem>65%\n2-10 replicas",  "staging"),
    ("canary-hpa-check",     "CPU>50%/Mem>60%\n2-15 replicas",  "canary"),
    ("prod-hpa-check",       "CPU>45%/Mem>55%\n5-50 replicas",  "production"),
]

# ─── Figure & axes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Palatino", "Palatino Linotype", "Georgia", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "figure.facecolor": BG,
    "axes.facecolor": BG,
    "savefig.facecolor": BG,
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.15,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H), dpi=DPI)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.axis("off")

TOTAL_X = X_OFF + N_COLS * COL_W + 0.3
TOTAL_Y = len(LANE_NAMES) * LANE_H

# ─── Swimlane backgrounds ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Column separators per environment
env_col_ranges = [
    ("dev",        0,  6,  "#3a6fa8"),
    ("staging",    7,  11, "#3a9993"),
    ("canary",     12, 18, "#c87020"),
    ("production", 19, 27, "#0e8a96"),
]

for lane_name in LANE_NAMES:
    idx = LANE_NAMES.index(lane_name)
    y0 = idx * LANE_H + 0.04
    rect = FancyBboxPatch(
        (X_OFF, y0), USABLE_W, LANE_H - 0.08,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
        linewidth=0.4, edgecolor=AXIS_C,
        facecolor=LANE_BG[lane_name], zorder=0
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(X_OFF - 0.1, y0 + (LANE_H - 0.08)/2,
            lane_name.capitalize(),
            fontsize=8.5, fontfamily="serif", color=TEXT2,
            va="center", ha="right", fontweight="bold")

# Rollback band
rb_h = LANE_H * 0.78
rb_y0 = -rb_h - 0.05
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
    (X_OFF, rb_y0), USABLE_W, rb_h,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
    linewidth=0.5, edgecolor="#c83030",
    facecolor=LANE_BG["rollback"], zorder=0, linestyle="--"
))
ax.text(X_OFF - 0.1, rb_y0 + rb_h/2,
        "Rollback\n/ Alert",
        fontsize=8, fontfamily="serif", color="#c83030",
        va="center", ha="right", fontweight="bold")

# Env boundary vertical lines
for _, c0, c1, col in env_col_ranges:
    bx = X_OFF + c0 * COL_W - COL_W * 0.3
    if c0 > 0:
        ax.axvline(bx, ymin=0.05, ymax=0.95,
                   color=AXIS_C, linewidth=0.6, linestyle=":", zorder=1,
                   clip_on=False)

# ─── Draw helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_node(ax, cx, cy, label, ntype):
    ec, fc, tc = TYPE_STYLE[ntype]
    if ntype == "decision":
        hw = NODE_W * 0.52
        hh = NODE_H * 1.05
        diam = plt.Polygon(
            [(cx, cy+hh), (cx+hw, cy), (cx, cy-hh), (cx-hw, cy)],
            closed=True, linewidth=0.7,
            edgecolor=ec, facecolor=fc, zorder=3
        )
        ax.add_patch(diam)
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.5, fontfamily="serif", color=tc, zorder=4,
                multialignment="center")
    elif ntype == "terminal":
        r = NODE_H * 0.65
        circ = plt.Circle((cx, cy), r,
                           linewidth=1.0, edgecolor=ec,
                           facecolor=fc, zorder=3)
        ax.add_patch(circ)
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.8, fontfamily="serif", color=tc, zorder=4,
                multialignment="center")
    else:
        box = FancyBboxPatch(
            (cx - NODE_W/2, cy - NODE_H/2), NODE_W, NODE_H,
            boxstyle=f"round,pad={CORNER}",
            linewidth=0.7, edgecolor=ec, facecolor=fc, zorder=3
        )
        ax.add_patch(box)
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.8, fontfamily="serif", color=tc, zorder=4,
                multialignment="center")

def draw_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, etype, lbl="", rad=0.0):
    col = EDGE_C[etype]
    ls  = (0, (4, 2)) if etype == "rollback" else "-"
    lw  = 0.8
    dx, dy = x1-x0, y1-y0
    dist   = (dx**2+dy**2)**0.5
    if dist < 0.01:
        return
    ux, uy = dx/dist, dy/dist
    # shrink start/end by node half-extent
    sk_x = NODE_W/2 * abs(ux) + NODE_H/2 * abs(uy)
    arr = FancyArrowPatch(
        (x0 + ux*sk_x*0.9, y0 + uy*sk_x*0.9),
        (x1 - ux*sk_x*0.9, y1 - uy*sk_x*0.9),
        arrowstyle=f"Simple,tail_width={lw*0.5},head_width=5,head_length=4",
        color=col, linewidth=lw, linestyle=ls,
        connectionstyle=f"arc3,rad={rad}",
        zorder=2, alpha=0.80,
    )
    ax.add_patch(arr)
    if lbl:
        mx = (x0 + x1)/2
        my = (y0 + y1)/2
        offset = 0.14 + abs(rad) * 0.6
        ax.text(mx, my + offset, lbl, ha="center", va="bottom",
                fontsize=4.5, fontfamily="serif", color=col,
                zorder=5, alpha=0.9)

# ─── Render nodes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for nid, (lbl, ntype) in ALL_NODES.items():
    cx, cy = centres[nid]
    draw_node(ax, cx, cy, lbl, ntype)

# ─── Render edges ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for frm, to, etype, lbl in EDGES:
    if frm not in centres or to not in centres:
        continue
    x0, y0 = centres[frm]
    x1, y1 = centres[to]

    # Determine curvature
    rad = 0.0
    if etype == "rollback":
        rad = 0.0  # straight down is fine for most
        if abs(x1 - x0) > COL_W * 3:
            rad = -0.15  # slight curve for long cross-lane rollbacks
    elif etype == "hpa_branch":
        rad = 0.25 if y1 > y0 else -0.25

    draw_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, etype, lbl, rad)

# ─── HPA threshold annotations ───────────────────────────────────────────────
for nid, annotation, lane in HPA_EDGES:
    cx, cy = centres[nid]
    # Small annotation box below the HPA node
    ax.text(cx, cy - NODE_H/2 - 0.16, annotation,
            ha="center", va="top",
            fontsize=4.2, fontfamily="serif",
            color="#5a30a0", alpha=0.8, zorder=6,
            style="italic",
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", fc="#f5eeff",
                      ec="#b090d8", lw=0.4, alpha=0.85))

# ─── Blue-green zone bracket ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
bg_node_ids = ["prod-blue-green-prep", "prod-deploy-green",
               "prod-green-healthcheck", "prod-switch-traffic",
               "prod-finalize"]
bg_xs = [centres[n][0] for n in bg_node_ids]
bg_cy = yc("production")
if bg_xs:
    bx0 = min(bg_xs) - NODE_W/2 - 0.08
    bx1 = max(bg_xs) + NODE_W/2 + 0.08
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
        (bx0, bg_cy - NODE_H/2 - 0.18),
        bx1 - bx0, NODE_H + 0.36,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
        linewidth=0.9, edgecolor="#0e8a96",
        facecolor="none", linestyle=(0, (4, 2)), zorder=5
    ))
    ax.text((bx0+bx1)/2, bg_cy + NODE_H/2 + 0.24,
            "Blue-Green Deployment Zone",
            ha="center", va="bottom",
            fontsize=6, fontfamily="serif",

    # Canary forward
    ("canary-deploy",    "canary-observe",       "forward",  ""),
    ("canary-observe",   "canary-hpa-check",     "forward",  "OK"),
    ("canary-hpa-check", "canary-ramp-25",       "forward",  "in range"),
    ("canary-ramp-25",   "canary-observe-2",     "forward",  ""),
    ("canary-observe-2", "canary-ramp-50",       "forward",  "OK"),
    ("canary-ramp-50",   "canary-gate",          "forward",  ""),

# ─── Render edges ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for frm, to, etype, lbl in EDGES:
    if frm not in centres or to not in centres:
        continue
    x0, y0 = centres[frm]
    x1, y1 = centres[to]

    # Cross-lane forward transitions (dev→staging, staging→canary, canary→prod)
    rad = 0.0
    if etype == "forward" and y1 != y0:
        # Down-and-right cross-lane: slight curve
        rad = -0.15
    elif etype == "rollback" and abs(x1 - x0) > COL_W * 2:
        # Long rollback lines to alert-oncall: curve under
        rad = 0.20
    elif etype == "hpa_branch":
        rad = 0.25 if y1 > y0 else -0.25

    draw_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, etype, lbl, rad)

# ─── HPA threshold annotations ───────────────────────────────────────────────
for nid, annotation in HPA_ANNOTATIONS:
    cx, cy = centres[nid]
    # Place below the node (toward bottom of lane)
    ax.text(cx, cy - NODE_H/2 - 0.14, annotation,
            ha="center", va="top",
            fontsize=4.2, fontfamily="serif",
            color="#5a30a0", alpha=0.85, zorder=6, style="italic",
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.12", fc="#f5eeff",
                      ec="#b090d8", lw=0.4, alpha=0.88))

bg_ids = ["prod-blue-green-prep","prod-deploy-green","prod-green-healthcheck",
          "prod-switch-traffic","prod-finalize"]
bg_xs  = [centres[n][0] for n in bg_ids]
bg_cy  = yc("production")
bx0    = min(bg_xs) - NODE_W/2 - 0.08
bx1    = max(bg_xs) + NODE_W/2 + 0.08
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
    (bx0, bg_cy - NODE_H/2 - 0.20), bx1-bx0, NODE_H + 0.40,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
    linewidth=0.9, edgecolor="#0e8a96", facecolor="none",
    linestyle=(0,(4,2)), zorder=5
))
ax.text((bx0+bx1)/2, bg_cy + NODE_H/2 + 0.25,
        "Blue-Green Deployment Zone",
        ha="center", va="bottom",
        fontsize=6, fontfamily="serif", color="#0e8a96",
        style="italic", zorder=6)

legend_items = [
    (mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#d6e8f7", edgecolor="#3a6fa8", lw=0.8), "Action"),

    (plt.Line2D([0],[0], color="#c83030", lw=1.4, ls=(0,(4,2))),       "Rollback path"),
    (plt.Line2D([0],[0], color="#0e8a96", lw=1.4),                     "Blue-green switch"),
]

leg = ax.legend(handles, labels,

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# ─── Palette ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG     = "#fffff8"
TEXT   = "#111111"
TEXT2  = "#555555"
AXIS_C = "#cccccc"

LANE_BG = {
    "dev":        "#e8f0fa",
    "staging":    "#e8f7e8",
    "canary":     "#fdf4e3",
    "production": "#fbe8e8",
    "rollback":   "#fff0f0",
}
TYPE_STYLE = {
    "action":    ("#3a6fa8", "#d6e8f7", "#1a3a60"),
    "check":     ("#3a9993", "#d8f0ee", "#1a5550"),
    "decision":  ("#c87020", "#fde8c8", "#6a3800"),
    "hpa":       ("#7a50b8", "#ecdaf7", "#3a1870"),
    "bg":        ("#0e8a96", "#c0ecf0", "#055860"),
    "rollback":  ("#c83030", "#fad8d8", "#700000"),
    "alert":     ("#a81010", "#fad8d8", "#600000"),
    "terminal":  ("#1a7a20", "#c8e8c8", "#0a4010"),
}
EDGE_C = {
    "forward":    "#4a7ab8",
    "rollback":   "#c83030",
    "hpa_branch": "#8a60c8",
    "blue_green": "#0e8a96",
}

# ─── Layout ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Lanes top-to-bottom: dev=3 (top), staging=2, canary=1, production=0
# Rollback band sits below production (y < 0)
# x flows left→right across pipeline stages

FIG_W, FIG_H = 22.0, 11.5
DPI = 150

LANE_ORDER = ["dev", "staging", "canary", "production"]  # top→bottom
N_LANES    = len(LANE_ORDER)
LANE_H     = 1.75
X_OFF      = 1.25   # space for lane labels

USABLE_W   = 20.2
N_COLS     = 28
COL_W      = USABLE_W / N_COLS
NODE_W     = COL_W * 0.83
NODE_H     = 0.52
CORNER     = 0.06

def xc(col):
    return X_OFF + col * COL_W + COL_W / 2

def yc(lane_name):
    # dev is at the top (highest y), production at bottom
    idx = LANE_ORDER.index(lane_name)   # 0=dev,1=staging,2=canary,3=prod
    # invert: dev→ top row (idx 0 → highest y)
    row = (N_LANES - 1) - idx           # dev→3, staging→2, canary→1, production→0
    return row * LANE_H + LANE_H / 2

RB_Y = -LANE_H * 0.48   # rollback band centre

# ─── Nodes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NODES = {
    # Dev (top lane)
    "src-commit":    ("Source Commit\n& PR Merge",      "action",   0,  "dev"),
    "ci-build":      ("CI Build &\nUnit Tests",          "action",   1,  "dev"),
    "docker-push":   ("Docker Build\n& Push",            "action",   2,  "dev"),
    "dev-deploy":    ("Deploy to\nDev NS",               "action",   3,  "dev"),
    "dev-smoke":     ("Smoke Tests",                     "check",    4,  "dev"),
    "dev-hpa-check": ("HPA Check\nDev",                  "hpa",      5,  "dev"),
    "dev-gate":      ("Dev Gate\nerr≥5%",                "decision", 6,  "dev"),
    # Staging
    "staging-deploy":      ("Deploy to\nStaging NS",          "action",   7,  "staging"),
    "staging-integration": ("Integration\n& E2E Tests",        "check",    8,  "staging"),
    "staging-hpa-check":   ("HPA Check\nStaging",              "hpa",      9,  "staging"),
    "staging-perf":        ("Perf / Load\nTests",              "check",    10, "staging"),
    "staging-gate":        ("Staging Gate\nerr≥2%",            "decision", 11, "staging"),
    # Canary
    "canary-deploy":    ("Deploy Canary\n10% Traffic",     "action",   12, "canary"),
    "canary-observe":   ("Observe\n5 min",                 "check",    13, "canary"),
    "canary-hpa-check": ("HPA Check\nCanary",              "hpa",      14, "canary"),
    "canary-ramp-25":   ("Ramp 25%\nTraffic",              "action",   15, "canary"),
    "canary-observe-2": ("Observe\n10 min",                "check",    16, "canary"),
    "canary-ramp-50":   ("Ramp 50%\nTraffic",              "action",   17, "canary"),
    "canary-gate":      ("Canary Gate\nerr≥1%/p99≥250ms", "decision", 18, "canary"),
    # Production (bottom lane)
    "prod-blue-green-prep":  ("Prepare\nGreen Slot",          "bg",       19, "production"),
    "prod-deploy-green":     ("Deploy to\nGreen Slot",         "bg",       20, "production"),
    "prod-green-healthcheck":("Green Health\nCheck",           "check",    21, "production"),
    "prod-hpa-check":        ("HPA Check\nProd",               "hpa",      22, "production"),
    "prod-bg-switch-gate":   ("B/G Switch\nGate ≥0.5%",       "decision", 23, "production"),
    "prod-switch-traffic":   ("Switch 100%\nTraffic→Green",    "bg",       24, "production"),
    "prod-verify":           ("Post-Switch\nVerify 3 min",     "check",    25, "production"),
    "prod-finalize":         ("Decommission\nBlue Slot",       "bg",       26, "production"),
    "pipeline-complete":     ("Pipeline\nComplete",             "terminal", 27, "production"),
}

# Rollbacks in the band below production
RB_NODES = {
    "rollback-dev":     ("Rollback Dev",            "rollback", 6),
    "rollback-staging": ("Rollback Staging",         "rollback", 11),
    "rollback-canary":  ("Rollback Canary",          "rollback", 18),
    "rollback-prod":    ("Revert→Blue",              "rollback", 23),
    "alert-oncall":     ("Alert On-Call\n& Incident","alert",    27),
}

# Compute centres
centres = {}
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col, lane) in NODES.items():
    centres[nid] = (xc(col), yc(lane))
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col) in RB_NODES.items():
    centres[nid] = (xc(col), RB_Y)

ALL_NODES = {}
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col, lane) in NODES.items():
    ALL_NODES[nid] = (lbl, ntype)
for nid, (lbl, ntype, col) in RB_NODES.items():
    ALL_NODES[nid] = (lbl, ntype)

# ─── Edges ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EDGES = [
    # Dev forward
    ("src-commit",    "ci-build",             "forward",    ""),
    ("ci-build",      "docker-push",          "forward",    "tests pass"),
    ("docker-push",   "dev-deploy",           "forward",    ""),
    ("dev-deploy",    "dev-smoke",            "forward",    ""),
    ("dev-smoke",     "dev-hpa-check",        "forward",    "pass"),
    ("dev-hpa-check", "dev-gate",             "forward",    "in range"),
    ("dev-gate",      "staging-deploy",       "forward",    "err<5%"),  # cross-lane
    ("dev-gate",      "rollback-dev",         "rollback",   "err>=5%"),
    ("rollback-dev",  "alert-oncall",         "rollback",   ""),
    # Staging forward
    ("staging-deploy",      "staging-integration",  "forward",  ""),
    ("staging-integration", "staging-hpa-check",    "forward",  "pass"),
    ("staging-hpa-check",   "staging-perf",         "forward",  "in range"),
    ("staging-perf",        "staging-gate",         "forward",  "pass"),
    ("staging-gate",        "canary-deploy",        "forward",  "err<2%"),  # cross-lane
    ("staging-gate",        "rollback-staging",     "rollback", "err>=2%"),
    ("staging-integration", "rollback-staging",     "rollback", "tests fail"),
    ("rollback-staging",    "alert-oncall",         "rollback", ""),
    # Canary forward
    ("canary-deploy",    "canary-observe",       "forward",  ""),
    ("canary-observe",   "canary-hpa-check",     "forward",  "OK"),
    ("canary-hpa-check", "canary-ramp-25",       "forward",  "in range"),
    ("canary-ramp-25",   "canary-observe-2",     "forward",  ""),
    ("canary-observe-2", "canary-ramp-50",       "forward",  "OK"),
    ("canary-ramp-50",   "canary-gate",          "forward",  ""),
    ("canary-gate",      "prod-blue-green-prep", "forward",  "err<1%\np99<250ms"),  # cross-lane
    ("canary-gate",      "rollback-canary",      "rollback", "err>=1%"),
    ("canary-observe",   "rollback-canary",      "rollback", "degraded"),
    ("canary-observe-2", "rollback-canary",      "rollback", "degraded"),
    ("rollback-canary",  "alert-oncall",         "rollback", ""),
    # Production
    ("prod-blue-green-prep",  "prod-deploy-green",      "blue_green", ""),
    ("prod-deploy-green",     "prod-green-healthcheck",  "blue_green", ""),
    ("prod-green-healthcheck","prod-hpa-check",          "forward",    "healthy"),
    ("prod-hpa-check",        "prod-bg-switch-gate",     "forward",    "in range"),
    ("prod-bg-switch-gate",   "prod-switch-traffic",     "blue_green", "err<0.5%\np99<200ms"),
    ("prod-bg-switch-gate",   "rollback-prod",           "rollback",   "err>=0.5%"),
    ("prod-green-healthcheck","rollback-prod",           "rollback",   "unhealthy"),
    ("rollback-prod",         "alert-oncall",            "rollback",   ""),
    ("prod-switch-traffic",   "prod-verify",             "blue_green", ""),
    ("prod-verify",           "prod-finalize",           "forward",    "verified"),
    ("prod-verify",           "rollback-prod",           "rollback",   "failed"),
    ("prod-finalize",         "pipeline-complete",       "forward",    ""),
]

HPA_ANNOTATIONS = [
    ("dev-hpa-check",     "CPU>60%/Mem>70%\n1–5 replicas"),
    ("staging-hpa-check", "CPU>55%/Mem>65%\n2–10 replicas"),
    ("canary-hpa-check",  "CPU>50%/Mem>60%\n2–15 replicas"),
    ("prod-hpa-check",    "CPU>45%/Mem>55%\n5–50 replicas"),
]

# ─── Figure ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Palatino", "Palatino Linotype", "Georgia", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "figure.facecolor": BG, "axes.facecolor": BG,
    "savefig.facecolor": BG, "savefig.bbox": "tight", "savefig.pad_inches": 0.15,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H), dpi=DPI)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.axis("off")

TOTAL_X = X_OFF + N_COLS * COL_W
TOTAL_Y = N_LANES * LANE_H

# ─── Swimlane backgrounds ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for lane_name in LANE_ORDER:
    row = (N_LANES - 1) - LANE_ORDER.index(lane_name)
    y0  = row * LANE_H + 0.04
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
        (X_OFF - 0.02, y0), USABLE_W + 0.04, LANE_H - 0.08,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
        linewidth=0.4, edgecolor=AXIS_C, facecolor=LANE_BG[lane_name], zorder=0
    ))
    ax.text(X_OFF - 0.12, y0 + (LANE_H-0.08)/2,
            lane_name.capitalize(),
            fontsize=8.5, fontfamily="serif", color=TEXT2,
            va="center", ha="right", fontweight="bold")

# Rollback band (below y=0)
rb_h  = LANE_H * 0.75
rb_y0 = -rb_h - 0.04
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
    (X_OFF - 0.02, rb_y0), USABLE_W + 0.04, rb_h,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
    linewidth=0.5, edgecolor="#c83030",
    facecolor=LANE_BG["rollback"], zorder=0, linestyle="--"
))
ax.text(X_OFF - 0.12, rb_y0 + rb_h/2,
        "Rollback\n/ Alert",
        fontsize=8, fontfamily="serif", color="#c83030",
        va="center", ha="right", fontweight="bold")

# ─── Env column header tabs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
env_ranges = [("DEV", 0, 6, "#3a6fa8"), ("STAGING", 7, 11, "#3a9993"),
              ("CANARY", 12, 18, "#c87020"), ("PRODUCTION", 19, 27, "#0e8a96")]
hdr_y = TOTAL_Y + 0.15
for env, c0, c1, col in env_ranges:
    bx0 = xc(c0) - NODE_W/2 - 0.03
    bx1 = xc(c1) + NODE_W/2 + 0.03
    mid = (bx0 + bx1) / 2
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
        (bx0, hdr_y - 0.13), bx1-bx0, 0.28,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
        linewidth=0.6, edgecolor=col,
        facecolor=LANE_BG.get(env.lower(), "#f5f5f5"), zorder=6
    ))
    ax.text(mid, hdr_y, env, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=7.5, fontfamily="serif", color=col, fontweight="bold", zorder=7)

# ─── Draw helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_node(ax, cx, cy, label, ntype):
    ec, fc, tc = TYPE_STYLE[ntype]
    if ntype == "decision":
        hw, hh = NODE_W * 0.52, NODE_H * 1.02
        ax.add_patch(plt.Polygon(
            [(cx, cy+hh),(cx+hw, cy),(cx, cy-hh),(cx-hw, cy)],
            closed=True, linewidth=0.7, edgecolor=ec, facecolor=fc, zorder=3))
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.5, fontfamily="serif", color=tc, zorder=4,
                multialignment="center")
    elif ntype == "terminal":
        r = NODE_H * 0.65
        ax.add_patch(plt.Circle((cx, cy), r,
                                 linewidth=1.0, edgecolor=ec, facecolor=fc, zorder=3))
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.8, fontfamily="serif", color=tc, zorder=4,
                multialignment="center")
    else:
        ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
            (cx - NODE_W/2, cy - NODE_H/2), NODE_W, NODE_H,
            boxstyle=f"round,pad={CORNER}",
            linewidth=0.7, edgecolor=ec, facecolor=fc, zorder=3))
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.8, fontfamily="serif", color=tc, zorder=4,
                multialignment="center")

def draw_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, etype, lbl="", rad=0.0):
    col = EDGE_C[etype]
    ls  = (0, (4, 2)) if etype == "rollback" else "-"
    lw  = 0.85
    dx, dy = x1-x0, y1-y0
    dist   = (dx**2+dy**2)**0.5
    if dist < 0.01:
        return
    ux, uy = dx/dist, dy/dist
    sk = (NODE_W/2*abs(ux) + NODE_H/2*abs(uy)) * 0.9
    arr = FancyArrowPatch(
        (x0+ux*sk, y0+uy*sk), (x1-ux*sk, y1-uy*sk),
        arrowstyle=f"Simple,tail_width={lw*0.4},head_width=5,head_length=4",
        color=col, linewidth=lw, linestyle=ls,
        connectionstyle=f"arc3,rad={rad}",
        zorder=2, alpha=0.82,
    )
    ax.add_patch(arr)
    if lbl:
        mx = (x0+x1)/2
        my = (y0+y1)/2 + abs(rad)*1.0
        ax.text(mx, my+0.10, lbl, ha="center", va="bottom",
                fontsize=4.5, fontfamily="serif", color=col, zorder=5, alpha=0.9)

# ─── Render nodes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for nid, (lbl, ntype) in ALL_NODES.items():
    draw_node(ax, *centres[nid], lbl, ntype)

# ─── Render edges ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for frm, to, etype, lbl in EDGES:
    if frm not in centres or to not in centres:
        continue
    x0, y0 = centres[frm]
    x1, y1 = centres[to]

    # Cross-lane forward transitions (dev→staging, staging→canary, canary→prod)
    rad = 0.0
    if etype == "forward" and y1 != y0:
        # Down-and-right cross-lane: slight curve
        rad = -0.15
    elif etype == "rollback" and abs(x1 - x0) > COL_W * 2:
        # Long rollback lines to alert-oncall: curve under
        rad = 0.20
    elif etype == "hpa_branch":
        rad = 0.25 if y1 > y0 else -0.25

    draw_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, etype, lbl, rad)

# ─── HPA threshold annotations ───────────────────────────────────────────────
for nid, annotation in HPA_ANNOTATIONS:
    cx, cy = centres[nid]
    # Place below the node (toward bottom of lane)
    ax.text(cx, cy - NODE_H/2 - 0.14, annotation,
            ha="center", va="top",
            fontsize=4.2, fontfamily="serif",
            color="#5a30a0", alpha=0.85, zorder=6, style="italic",
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.12", fc="#f5eeff",
                      ec="#b090d8", lw=0.4, alpha=0.88))

# ─── Blue-green zone bracket ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
bg_ids = ["prod-blue-green-prep","prod-deploy-green","prod-green-healthcheck",
          "prod-switch-traffic","prod-finalize"]
bg_xs  = [centres[n][0] for n in bg_ids]
bg_cy  = yc("production")
bx0    = min(bg_xs) - NODE_W/2 - 0.08
bx1    = max(bg_xs) + NODE_W/2 + 0.08
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch(
    (bx0, bg_cy - NODE_H/2 - 0.20), bx1-bx0, NODE_H + 0.40,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
    linewidth=0.9, edgecolor="#0e8a96", facecolor="none",
    linestyle=(0,(4,2)), zorder=5
))
ax.text((bx0+bx1)/2, bg_cy + NODE_H/2 + 0.25,
        "Blue-Green Deployment Zone",
        ha="center", va="bottom",
        fontsize=6, fontfamily="serif", color="#0e8a96",
        style="italic", zorder=6)

# ─── Legend ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_items = [
    (mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#d6e8f7", edgecolor="#3a6fa8", lw=0.8), "Action"),
    (mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#d8f0ee", edgecolor="#3a9993", lw=0.8), "Check / test"),
    (mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#fde8c8", edgecolor="#c87020", lw=0.8), "Decision gate"),
    (mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#ecdaf7", edgecolor="#7a50b8", lw=0.8), "HPA checkpoint"),
    (mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#c0ecf0", edgecolor="#0e8a96", lw=0.8), "Blue-green step"),
    (mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#fad8d8", edgecolor="#c83030", lw=0.8), "Rollback / alert"),
    (plt.Line2D([0],[0], color="#4a7ab8", lw=1.4),                     "Forward / cross-lane"),
    (plt.Line2D([0],[0], color="#c83030", lw=1.4, ls=(0,(4,2))),       "Rollback path"),
    (plt.Line2D([0],[0], color="#0e8a96", lw=1.4),                     "Blue-green switch"),
]
handles, labels = zip(*legend_items)
leg = ax.legend(handles, labels,
                loc="upper center",
                bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.09),
                ncol=5, fontsize=7.5,
                frameon=True, framealpha=0.97,
                edgecolor=AXIS_C, facecolor=BG,
                handlelength=1.6, handletextpad=0.5, columnspacing=1.2)
for txt in leg.get_texts():
    txt.set_fontfamily("serif")

# ─── Titles ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.text(X_OFF, TOTAL_Y + 0.70,
        "Kubernetes Multi-Environment Deployment Pipeline",
        fontsize=15, fontfamily="serif", color=TEXT, va="bottom")
ax.text(X_OFF, TOTAL_Y + 0.43,
        "Sequential flow: Dev → Staging → Canary (10%→25%→50%) → Production (Blue-Green)  "
        "·  Error thresholds tighten at each gate: 5% → 2% → 1% → 0.5%  "
        "·  All rollbacks auto-trigger",
        fontsize=7.5, fontfamily="serif", color=TEXT2, va="bottom")

# ─── Axis limits ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.set_xlim(0.0, TOTAL_X + 0.4)
ax.set_ylim(rb_y0 - 0.18, TOTAL_Y + 0.82)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.07, 1, 1.0])
plt.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=DPI)
print("Saved /app/output/result.png")
